findings.comment: Proposed floor area ratio is 0.891:1 (gross floor area 83,986 sf ÷ site area 94,192 sf), which exceeds the MF-2 zoning maximum of 0.5:1 per LDC § 25-2-492. No approved variance, density bonus, or other exemption is documented on the site plan or in supplementary applications. Either reduce the proposed gross floor area to achieve a compliant FAR of 0.5:1 or lower, or submit documentation of an approved variance from the Board of Adjustment.
